nom: SOME BY MI AHA BHA PHA 30 Days Miracle Acne Clear Body Cleanser

avis.texte: I absolutely love this product and will be repurchasing for the rest of my life. I always struggled with back acne to the point where i would get back facials and even a biopsy for a blackhead. This cleared up my skin and it felt so smooth after showers. I saw someone comment on the scent but I personally found it really refreshing!

I'm seeing comments that it has a strong smell. But one of the things I liked about it was that the scent of tea tree is very light and almost imperceptible, especially because I'm very sensitive to odors. i've been using it for a few weeks now. And have struggled with spots of acne on my back from working out and it has cleared those and any leftover acne marks from previous blemishes. My skin feels soft and I will definitely keep using this. i even recently started using it on my face to see if it will clear stubborn blackheads on my chin, and my skin already looks glowy after a few days.

I can't speak to the efficacy of the product, aka how well it works for body acne and KP. The instructions are a bit strange "apply to cleansed skin". Mind you, it's a body cleanser. But I've only heard positive things about Korean skin care, and with the buy one get one half off deal, I took the risk as to save some money on products for body acne and kp. It has a very strong tea tree and medicinal smell, like hospital soap with tea tree oil. I smelled a bit after the gym and it cleared it out. But the smell of the soap has lingered enough and even aired through my body moisturizer, which to be fair has a light scent. It dried out my skin a bit, so I'll alternate between a moisturizing body wash.
